subject.title: fix(agents): keep auto-compaction on the live session model (#95696)

question: Should timeout and overflow compaction inherit a pending live-session `/model` provider/model/auth profile selection when the active attempt cannot restart cleanly?
rationale: This fixes the linked bug, but it intentionally changes auth-provider routing for compaction and needs maintainer acceptance of the upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept live-switch compaction routing
options.body: Land the PR after confirming compaction should follow the pending live selection and drop stale cross-provider auth profiles.

options.title: Require live multi-provider capture
options.body: Ask for a real timeout or overflow compaction run with two providers before deciding the auth-routing change.

recommendation.title: Accept live-switch compaction routing
recommendation.body: Land the PR after confirming compaction should follow the pending live selection and drop stale cross-provider auth profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the live model switch and selected session model resolution history.
